Turret under attack
Police forces on the planet Varuna are responding to a bank robbery in progress in the great city of Mahanagar.
Stay tuned to FED NET as this story unfolds.
Would you like to know more?
Planet Varuna, home to Mahanagar, a giant in the economic market and one of the most brightly shining cities in the Federation.
Built on the Ganda River, the island city offers natural protection against the Arachnid presence on the planet.
While the odd stray Arachnid may slip through the net,
the real fight is against the criminals who seek to disturb the peaceful lives of our citizens.
But justice is carried out by the likes of Officer Kayla Keys.
The local police negotiator is en route to the crime scene.
We now take you live to Mahanagar to follow the progress of this story.
An outbreak of Arachnids in the northern district of Mahanagar has prompted the Mobile Infantry to mount an armed response.
On occasion, small pockets of Bugs will manage to tunnel their way below the shallow marshlands.
For the safety of citizens, a Mobile Infantry detachment remains permanently stationed in the city.
These brave troopers have arrived at the local railway station to clear the streets by sunrise.
Their service guarantees your safe morning commute!
Further Bug-related incidents have been reported across the outer districts of Mahanagar.
Governor Govac has issued his assurance that the situation is under control,
and that citizens in the city center will remain safe to go on with their day unperturbed.
Drums of gunfire may be heard occasionally across the hot zones.
That’s the comforting sound of our troopers driving the Bugs back into the river!
The Arachnid outbreak in Mahanagar has grown in scale.
Accepting responsibility for the debacle, Governor Govac has resigned from his position,
placing the city under martial law as his last official act.
The Bugs must be stopped in their march toward the central district, and Terran Command has the answer:
The tactical destruction of all district bridges!
TAC fighters operating from the city starport are already in flight to execute this plan with pinpoint destructive precision!
The Arachnid march has been thwarted after the victorious destruction of Mahanagar's main bridges.
But reports have shown the Bugs are now digging into the metro system to continue their advance through the underground.
Is there a Brain Bug on planet Varuna?
Federal scientists are investigating the well orchestrated movements of the Arachnids.
To defeat the Bug, we must stay one step ahead!
The enemy may think they control the board, but our new gambit will put them in check!
The presence of a Brain Bug leading the attacks on Mahanagar has been confirmed.
Now that we know our enemy, we have the means to defeat it!
Federal scientists have exposed a major weakness in the Arachnid's offensive capabilities.
Armed with this tactical knowledge, the advanced water systems of Mahanagar will be used to flood the outer districts.
Tens of thousands of Bugs will drown, and the Brain Bug will remain trapped and isolated in the city center.
Flooding the outer districts of Mahanagar has dealt the Arachnid invasion a heavy blow!
But our battle for the heart of the city still rages on.
The starport of Mahanagar has fallen.
The Brain Bug has directed its remaining hordes to disrupt the shipments of new equipment and personnel at this vital transport hub.
Our troopers have fought hard, but shortages are now being felt on the battlefield, leaving our position hanging in the balance.
To regain the upper hand, the starport must be taken back.
Eager to finish the job, Mobile Infantry forces are steadily closing in on the Brain Bug's final hiding spot.
Total victory is close at hand in Mahanagar!
No escape, tricks, or countermoves remain for the Bug!
The brave men and women of the Mobile Infantry have restored order on the streets of Mahanagar.
Now, one final battle awaits below the city.
Cowering in the stench of the sewers and the burning husks of its minions,the Brain Bug will soon face its final retribution!
After a hard-fought battle, the Mobile Infantry has achieved ultimate victory in Mahanagar.
Many did their part and gave their life in service of a great cause: protecting the wellbeing of our citizens.
The city, too, has paid a heavy toll...
But out of ashes comes new opportunities as we rebuild to a new tomorrow. A better tomorrow!
Winning wars requires special people with special skills.
Sergeant Kayla Keys was one such hero and she gave her life to assure the ultimate victory.
Do you think you are psychic?
Don’t let your talents go to waste!
Call this number to begin your journey today!
Early identification saves lives!
